tenderSchedule.title: Hiring of Bolero/Swift desire/Toyota-ETIOS or Similar Compact sedan or sedan type(Non Ac) for a period of 12 months for O/O Assistant Executive Engineer PRE Sub Division Periyapattana.
tenderSchedule.description: Hiring of Bolero/Swift desire/Toyota-ETIOS or Similar Compact sedan or sedan type(Non Ac) for a period of 12 months for O/O Assistant Executive Engineer PRE Sub Division Periyapattana.
tenderSchedule.deptName: Rural Development and Panchayat Raj Department
tenderSchedule.locationName: RDPR Division Office K R Nagara

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

The bidder is required to ensure browser compatibility of the computer well in advance to the last date and time for receipt of tenders. The departments shall not be responsible for non-accessibility of e Procurement portal due to internet connectivity issues and technical glitches at bidder s end

Performance Security Deposit amounting to 5% of the amount put to tender has to be provided at the time of Tender agreement in the form of FDR per vehicle in the favour of Executive Engineer, PRE Division, K R Nagara for a period of One year from any nationalized bank. The same shall be forefieted by the authority if the bidder fails to provide the vehicle during the tendered agreement year
The Agency / Tenderer shall be duly registered under relevant government enactment and should produce the relevant document
The Agency / Tenderer should have valid registration certificate regarding income tax /service tax and should produce all the relevant documents from the concerned department.

Vehicle should be registered and copy should be produced. The vehicle model should not be more than 3 years (i.e vehicle purchased or registered on or after 2019). The Agency / Tenderer should produce original registration certificate for verification
The Agency / Tenderer should provide relevant documents regarding his address proof and driving licence
Vehicle insurance certificate should be provided
The Agency / Tenderer should produce permit, GST, TIN and PAN No, Last five year annual turnover certificate given by CA and Emission test certificates
All terms and conditions are as per uploaded tender documents
The Bidder should submit copy of RC book of vehicle registered in his Name OR shall submit the proof for having booked the offered vehicle / vehicles in his name.
Vehicle shall be made available on all 365 days of the year (including Sundays & General Holidays
Bata,Overtime Duty or Night halt charges will not be provided. Vehicle Maintenance, Fuel and repairs shall be the responsibility of the bidder and should provide yellow board vehicles
If the bidder doesnot provide the vehicle of any one of the days, then the rent of that day will be deducted as per proreta rates
The driver shall maintain a log book and has to get it certified by the concerned officer without fail

The driver engaged shall not be less than 18 years of age with qualified and good experience of driving and should have a verified report obtained by the Police in respect of their character and antecedents

The vehicle will be accepted until the requirements of the office. It shall be the sole responsibility of the undersigned authority to stop the vehicle procurement for any reasons and no compensation will be provided

The contractor shall ensure that driver engaged by him to drive the vehicle shall fulfil and comply with the requirement of motor vehicle act, and other statutory provisions. If driver of the vehicle is found unfit to drive the vehicle, Assistant Executive Engineer will have full power to refuse the services of the driver and the agency shall provide an alternate driving personnel immediately
The agency shall provide replacement for driver, in event of his sickness absence or availing leave, National holidays, Weekly off and this provision is provided in the scope of contract

Vehicle shall not be diverted to any works outside PRED jurisdiction during idle time of the vehicle. Thus, all vehicles provided under this contract shall be for the exclusive use of PRED during the entire period of the contract

The Department will not be responsible for any of the unauthorized acts and or liable for any damage / injury sustained by agency or any other person in the course of their work / duty in and around the office
It shall be the sole responsibility of the EE PRED DIVISION K R NAGARA authority to accept or reject the tender without any reasons
